source_basis: Samsung Electronics 2025 4Q Conference Call PDF — measured pixel values + v3 page 1:1 mirror plan
v3_changes_summary: v2의 색·타이포·시그니처는 그대로 유지하되, 우리 10p 표준 슬롯이 원본 15p 중 어느 페이지를 1:1 mirror할지 명시한 page_mirror_plan 추가. visual_vocabulary 사전(카드/차트/표/다이어그램/섹션/푸터) 카탈로그화.

color.deprecated_v1_accent: #1428A0 — DO NOT USE; v1 assumption replaced by measured #0028A8
color.palette_notes: Single brand accent #0028A8 only. No additional blue variants, no rainbow category palette, no green/red growth coding. Past chart bars #A5B3C6 + current bar #0028A8 = 2-color chart system.

page_title.fallback: Inter, Pretendard, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

section_label.usage: Section labels above charts or to left of charts (Quarterly Results, Full-year Results, DS results, MX/NW results, Sales, Operating Profit)

kpi_huge.size_note: v1 assumption was 56pt — measured actual is 44-48pt. DO NOT use 56pt.
kpi_huge.unit_suffix_treatment: trailing T at same size and same color as digits (no subscript, no superscript, no smaller size)

kpi_sub_label.usage: Sales / Operating Profit labels above KPI numbers

bullet_headline.usage: Bold summary line at start of each commentary bullet group

table_header_cell.alignment: right for numeric, left for label column

table_body_cell.alignment: right for numeric, left for label column

table_growth_indicator.color_note: BOTH directions same Samsung Blue — direction conveyed by glyph (↑ or ↓) only. Green-up/red-down coding ABSOLUTELY FORBIDDEN.

chart_value_label_in_bar.alignment: centered horizontally and vertically inside bar / dot

wordmark_samsung_top_right.consistency: Present on body pages p-02~p-14 (13 pages). ABSENT on cover (p-01) and closing (p-15) — those pages use bottom-band wordmark instead.

index_nav_label.usage: Index page only — PRESENTERS | 4Q 2025 FINANCIAL RESULTS | PERFORMANCE BY BUSINESS SEGMENT | APPENDICES

korean_font_strategy.fallback: Noto Sans KR, Apple SD Gothic Neo, sans-serif
korean_font_strategy.weight_mapping: Pretendard 700 = page title and KPI huge; Pretendard 600 = section label, table header, bullet headline, growth indicator; Pretendard 400 = body, table cell, bullet detail

type.deprecated_v1_fonts: IBM Plex Sans + IBM Plex Mono — DO NOT USE. v1 assumption replaced by Manrope (open fallback for SamsungOne/SamsungSharpSans).

spacing.grid: content-driven asymmetric (not strict 12-column). Outer margins 4% fixed; left/right block split varies per page (1:1, 3:2, 1:2, 1:1).

shape.border_card: none (KPI numerals are bare text, no card box)
shape.emphasis_method: Samsung Blue text or Samsung Blue 5px rectangle border around current-period table column. No solid fill emphasis on body pages.

top_hairline.x_span_pct: 3.8% to 83.3% (left-aligned, stops short to clear top-right wordmark)

page_common_elements_mandatory_on_body_p.page_number: ABSENT — no page numbers anywhere in deck

cover_p01_layout.note: Cover does NOT carry the top hairline or top-right wordmark. Both functions are taken over by the bottom footer band (white hairline on top edge + SAMSUNG wordmark on right side of band).

thank_you_p15_layout.note: Closing does NOT carry the top hairline or top-right wordmark. Uses bottom hairline (no filled band) + bottom-right SAMSUNG wordmark.
thank_you_p15_layout.no_footer_band: Unlike cover, closing has NO filled #0E1930 band. Just hairline + wordmark on dark photo overlay.

body_page_header_gradient.function: very subtle vertical fade to lift title; NOT a colored banner. Almost invisible.

chart.template: single repeating template — bar + line combo (bar = sales, line = OP)
chart.data_encoding: 2-color: past period bars #A5B3C6 gray + current rightmost bar #0028A8 Samsung Blue. NO multi-color category palette. NO multiple blue variations.
chart.paired_bars: ABSOLUTELY FORBIDDEN. Two series at same x-position must be STACKED, never side-by-side.

op_line_overlay.position: floats above bars, layered on top

value_label_in_bar.position: inside bar, centered horizontally and vertically

chart.axis_baseline: very faint, barely visible. NO y-axis line, NO horizontal gridlines, NO tick marks.

legend.style: no box. Mini-legend at bottom-center: small gray rectangle + 'Sales(KRW trillion)' / small white-fill circle + 'OP(KRW trillion)'

chart.unit_caption_position: header right or above chart group, 'KRW trillion' or 'KRW billion'

annotation_arc.usage: p-06 only — curve + arrow + '+24% YoY' label connecting first and last bars

stacked_bar.usage: p-08 Memory only — Sales(Mem) bottom + Sales(DS) top per x position
stacked_bar.past_periods: both layers in gray tonal steps of #A5B3C6
stacked_bar.current_period: DS layer in #0028A8, Mem layer remains gray

single_bar_no_op.usage: p-09 S.LSI/Foundry only — bar_op_combo_frameless without OP line

two_stacked_charts_per_page.usage: p-12 VD/DA/Harman only — left column carries two charts stacked vertically (VD/DA top, Harman bottom)

chart.source_footnote: ABSENT in original deck — DO NOT add 'Source: ...' footnote
chart.render: SVG precise. No div blocks. No 3D. No pie. No donut. No truncated y-axis.

table.indent_hierarchy: progressive left indent in first column (Total → DX → MX/NW → MX). 0.2in per level. No grouping rules, no background bands.

current_period_highlight.span: from header row (top) through last body row continuously
current_period_highlight.applies_to_columns: the single current-period column (4Q25 or 2025 or 31.Dec.25) — and on p-06 main table, both 4Q25 column AND its accompanying % of sales 4Q25 column together

growth_indicator.color_note: BOTH same Samsung Blue — direction by glyph only. NEVER green/red.

table.alignment: label column left, numeric columns right
table.footnote_block: small ※-marked footnote bottom-right of certain tables (p-07), Manrope 400 9pt #A5B3C6, 2-3 lines

diagram.philosophy: Original deck has almost NO traditional diagrams (no segment tree, no process flow, no 2x2 matrix). The 'diagram' page kind uses the commentary template (chart left + nested bullets right with #0D2062 hairline tab labels) instead.

kpi_huge_combo.structure: 2 or 4 KPI giant numbers in #0028A8 44-48pt Manrope 800 tabular (with 'T' suffix at same size), each with small sub-label above (Sales / Operating Profit, Manrope 400 11pt #A5B3C6). Section label (#3D4E6F 14pt 600) at top. Bar+line chart below. NO card box, NO border — bare text only.
kpi_huge_combo.layout: left half: Quarterly Results (Sales KPI + OP KPI + chart) | right half: Full-year Results (Sales KPI + OP KPI + chart)

commentary_tab_hairline.usage: p-08 through p-12 right side — each timeframe section header
commentary_tab_hairline.label_below_or_chip: Manrope 600 14pt #010821 text below hairline, OR small #0D2062 chip with #FFFFFF text inline with hairline
commentary_tab_hairline.treatment: hairline + text only — NOT a filled tab band

index_navigation.structure: horizontal row of 4 UPPERCASE labels, each preceded by 1px vertical | glyph

presenters_grid.structure: row of 8 circular portraits (diameter ~1.4in, placeholder gray circles in fixture) with name/EVP/role caption below in Manrope 600 12pt + Manrope 400 10pt white. Two grouping labels above ('Presenters' / 'Moderator').

explicitly_forbidden_in_this_pack: segment tree (root + children) — NOT in original deck
process flow (numbered rectangle nodes with arrows) — NOT in original deck
2x2 matrix with cross axis — NOT in original deck
waterfall / bridge chart — NOT in original deck
pull-quote with left blue bar — NOT in original deck
timeline with milestone circles — NOT in original deck
KPI cards with borders / panel fills — original uses bare text KPI

slide.transition: subtle — top hairline + wordmark fade in 150ms ease-out on first slide only; body content instant cut on subsequent slides. No slide/bounce/glow/zoom/flip/push.

page_mirror_plan.description: v3 핵심 산출물. 우리 10p 표준 슬롯이 원본 15p 중 어느 페이지를 1:1 mirror할지 명시. 각 슬롯은 mirror_of(미러 원본) + what_to_copy(복사할 핵심 요소) + deviation_allowed(허용 변형) + must_avoid(금지 변형)의 4축으로 정의.

what_to_copy: 다크 네이비(#06122A) + Samsung Seocho 빌딩 사진 오버레이 (rgba(6,18,42,0.78))
좌측 정렬 큰 타이틀 SamsungSharpSans-Bold 자리에 Manrope 700 60-72pt 흰색 2줄
바닥 19% 다크 네이비 푸터 밴드 #0E1930 + 윗변 흰 hairline
좌측 푸터: 'Earnings Presentation: / 4Q 2025 Financial Results' 2줄 14pt
우측 푸터: SAMSUNG 워드마크 14pt
상단 hairline 부재 + 우상단 워드마크 부재 (cover 특이사항)
deviation_allowed: 사진은 비슷한 톤의 다른 빌딩/추상 텍스처 가능

what_to_copy: 다크 BG + (옵션) 칩 매크로 사진 오버레이
좌상단 'Index' 타이틀 Manrope 700 40pt 흰색
중앙 y≈50%에 4-5개 UPPERCASE 라벨 가로 1행 배열
각 라벨 앞에 vertical '|' 1px 흰선 (y 48-58%)
라벨 폰트: Manrope 600 UPPERCASE 13pt wide tracking +0.04em 흰색
상단 hairline + 우상단 SAMSUNG 워드마크 표준 위치
deviation_allowed: 라벨 텍스트는 우리 콘텐츠 섹션명으로 교체

what_to_copy: 다크 네이비 BG + faint 사진/텍스처
상단 hairline + 우상단 SAMSUNG 워드마크
좌상단 큰 타이틀 Manrope 700 36pt 흰색
타이틀 아래 좌/우 그룹 라벨 + 얇은 흰 hairline 언더라인
(옵션 A) 8개 circular portrait placeholder + 캡션 3줄
(옵션 B) p-02 처럼 본문 텍스트로만 채우는 변형
deviation_allowed: 섹션 번호 추가 가능(UPPERCASE + wide tracking + 흰색)

what_to_copy: WHITE BG + 상단 hairline + 우상단 워드마크 #0028A8
타이틀 Manrope 700 36pt #010821 + 부제 Manrope 400 12pt #A5B3C6
2-4개 거대 KPI 숫자 Manrope 800 44-48pt #0028A8 tabular ('T' 동일 크기)
각 KPI 위에 sub 라벨 Manrope 400 11pt #A5B3C6
KPI 묶음 위에 섹션 라벨 Manrope 600 14pt #3D4E6F
차트는 생략 또는 단순화
deviation_allowed: 단위 접미사(T/B/%/명) 자유, 단 숫자 동일 크기

what_to_copy: WHITE BG + 표준 헤더
3 막대 (과거2 회색 #A5B3C6 + 현재1 #0028A8) + OP 라인(흰 원 dot + 흰 connector)
막대 안에 값 텍스트 직접 (흰색 on 파랑, #010821 on 회색)
frameless: y축/gridline/외곽 frame 완전 부재
x축 baseline은 거의 invisible 얇은 선만
wavy '~' axis-break glyph (불연속 시기)
mini-legend (회색 사각 + 'Sales' / 흰 원 + 'OP') 박스 없음
(옵션) p-06 curved annotation arrow #0028A8 1pt
deviation_allowed: OP 라인 없는 단일 막대 (p-09 양식)

what_to_copy: WHITE BG + 표준 헤더
좌측 28-30% 차트 또는 비주얼 + 우측 65% 텍스트 commentary 블록
우측 commentary에 3-4개 timeframe section을 #0D2062 2px 가로 hairline + 작은 navy 라벨 chip/텍스트로 구분
각 section: 1-3개 굵은 헤드라인 Manrope 600 12-13pt + 그 아래 dot bullet detail Manrope 400 11pt
헤드라인 좌측에 작은 #0028A8 dot 또는 4px stroke (선택)
section 간 24px 간격, hairline y ≈27%, 49%, 71%

slots.mirror_of: p-07 (좌우 표 2개 — Results by Business Segment)
what_to_copy: WHITE BG + 표준 헤더
좌/우 50:50 분할 — 각 'Sales' / 'Operating profit' sub-title (Manrope 600 14pt) + 데이터 표
각 표는 row hairline #D8DBE2 + 최신 컬럼 #0028A8 5px border + #BBD2E8 fill
행 첫 컬럼에 hierarchical indent (0~3 level)
subtotal 행 Manrope 600
우측 표 하단에 작은 ※-주석 (Manrope 400 8pt #5C6B90)
deviation_allowed: 카드 그리드 (2x2, 2x3, 3x2)로 변형 가능 — 단 hairline + 강조 컬럼만으로 강조
데이터 적으면 mini-indicator table 양식 차용

what_to_copy: WHITE BG + 표준 헤더
좌 60% 메인 비교 표 (label + 3-4 비교 컬럼) + 최우측 컬럼 #0028A8 5px border + #BBD2E8 fill
우 38% 보조 mini-table (ratio/지표) + 동일 강조 컬럼
표 row hairline #D8DBE2만, vertical rule/외곽 frame 부재
subtotal/total 행 Manrope 600
footnote: 표 하단 Manrope 400 8pt #5C6B90
WHITE BG + 표준 헤더
좌 28-30% 차트(bar_op_combo_frameless) + 'XXX results' 섹션 라벨
우 65% timeframe/sub-category commentary
각 section #0D2062 hairline + 헤드라인 + 들여쓴 bullet 3-5줄 (narrative 톤 무겁게)
필요 시 sub-category 헤더 (Manrope 600 12pt #010821) 헤드라인 위에 추가
deviation_allowed: 왼쪽 차트가 표/이미지 대체 가능 (XXX results 라벨 유지)
p-12 처럼 좌측 차트 2개 stacked OK

what_to_copy: 다크 네이비 #06122A + Seocho 빌딩 사진(표지와 다른 앵글) + rgba(6,18,42,0.78) 오버레이
중앙 큰 'Thank you' Manrope 700 80pt 흰색 가운데 정렬 Title Case
y≈87%에 얇은 흰 1px hairline (x 3.8-83.3%)
우하단 SAMSUNG 워드마크 흰색 14pt 700
상단 hairline 부재 + 우상단 워드마크 부재
푸터 밴드 부재 (closing 특이사항 — hairline만)
deviation_allowed: 'Thank you' 외 closing 문구('Q&A', '감사합니다') 가능 — Title Case 한 줄

pages.label: 핵심 메시지 (Highlights KPI pair)
pages.layout: 1:1 left/right — Quarterly Results | Full-year Results, each with 2 KPI numbers (chart optional/simplified)

pages.label: 데이터 차트 (bar_op_combo_frameless)
pages.layout: single chart or 1:1 split — bar_op_combo_frameless template

pages.label: 다이어그램 (Memory commentary 양식)
pages.layout: 1:2 left/right — chart left, 3-4 timeframe sections with #0D2062 tab hairlines right

pages.label: 인포그래픽 카드 그리드 (Business Segment 표 2개)
pages.layout: 1:1 left/right — Sales table + OP table side-by-side, hierarchical indent, current column highlight

pages.label: 비교 표 (Appendix 1 — main + mini-table)
pages.layout: 3:2 left/right — main comparison table + side mini-table, latest column highlighted

pages.label: 인용·서술 (segment commentary 양식)
pages.layout: 1:2 left/right — chart left + heavy timeframe commentary right

pages.label: 결론 (Thank you)
pages.content: centered 'Thank you' 80pt + bottom hairline + bottom-right wordmark. NO footer band.
